title: terrain.brace_strut_placed
description: M14F brace-strut placement event. Emitted when the player uses the `brace_strut_t1` / `brace_strut_t2` / `brace_strut_t3` tool: debits the per-tier crafting cost, locks the ±N lateral pixels around the placement to integrity 500 (N scales by tier per VAL-M14F-031), and writes the support material to the terrain.

actor_id.description: Actor id of the player who placed the strut.

chunk_id.description: Chunk coordinate the placement landed in.

lateral_cell.description: Lateral-axis integrity-field cell coordinate (lx, ly) within the chunk's 16×16 buffer.

cost.description: Inventory delta the placement applied. Per VAL-M14F-022: T1 = 2 iron + 1 wood; T2/T3 element-wise ≥ T1.

lock_radius_px.description: Lock radius (in pixels) applied to the lateral integrity field around the placement. T1=8, T2=12, T3=16 per VAL-M14F-031.
